checker:
Classify the AI system described below by answering the following questions in order. Base every answer only on the description and on the provisions in your instructions.

Q1. Is the system an AI practice prohibited under Article 5?
Q2. Is the system a product, or a safety component of a product, covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I, and is that product required to undergo a third-party conformity assessment (Article 6(1))?
Q3. Does the intended purpose of the system fall within a use case listed in Annex III, taking into account the exclusions stated there?
Q4. If Q3 is yes: does a derogation under Article 6(3) apply? Remember that an Annex III system that performs profiling of natural persons is always high-risk. If Q3 is no, answer null.
Q5. Does any obligation under Article 50(1) to (4) apply to the system?

Then derive the risk class: "prohibited" if Q1 is yes; otherwise "high_risk" if Q2 is yes, or if Q3 is yes and Q4 is no; otherwise "transparency_only" if Q5 is yes; otherwise "minimal".

Return only this JSON object:
{"q1_prohibited": true | false, "q2_annex_I": true | false, "q3_annex_III": true | false, "q4_art6_3_derogation": true | false | null, "q5_art50": true | false, "risk_class": "prohibited" | "high_risk" | "transparency_only" | "minimal", "justification": "<at most 60 words>"}

AI system description:
<<DESCRIPTION>>
